## Land Cover

```{r}
#| label: setup-landcover
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/landcover/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-landcover
#| include: false
lc <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_lc.csv")), col_types = "cd") %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Land Cover Type`), `Pixel Count` > 0) %>%
    mutate(Percent = `Pixel Count` / sum(`Pixel Count`)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Percent)) %>%
    mutate(`Land Cover Type` = factor(`Land Cover Type`, levels = `Land Cover Type`))
}, error = function(e) { message("lc not available: ", e$message); NULL })
```

```{r}
#| label: landcover
#| results: asis

if (is.null(lc) || nrow(lc) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No Landcover file available")) else {

  print_paged_df(lc)

  lc_colors <- c(
    "Tree cover" = "#397e48",
    "Built-up" = "#c4281b",
    "Grassland" = "#88af52",
    "Bare / sparse vegetation" = "#a59b8f",
    "Cropland" = "#e49634",
    "Permanent water bodies" = "#429bdf",
    "Shrubland" = "#dfc25a",
    "Herbaceous wetland" = "#7d87c4",
    "Mangroves" = "#00cf75")

  lc_plot <- ggdonut(lc, "Land Cover Type", "Percent", colors = lc_colors, show_legend = TRUE)
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-lc-pieplot.png"), plot = lc_plot, device = "png",
        width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(lc_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  lc1 <- lc$`Land Cover Type`[1]
  lc1_pct <- lc$Percent[1] %>% scales::percent(0.1)
  lc2 <- lc$`Land Cover Type`[2]
  lc2_pct <- lc$Percent[2] %>% scales::percent(0.1)
  lc3 <- lc$`Land Cover Type`[3]
  lc3_pct <- lc$Percent[3] %>% scales::percent(0.1)

  print_text(paste0(paste_bold(lc1), " comprises the majority of land in the ", paste_bold(city), " area of interest (", paste_bold(lc1_pct), ")."))
  print_text(paste0("The next largest land classes are ", paste_bold( lc2), " (", paste_bold(lc2_pct), ") and ", paste_bold(lc3), " (", paste_bold(lc3_pct), ")"))

}
```
